content.text: {"title":"Ravi packs the boxes","gradeSubjectTag":"Class 5 · Maths · Multiplication","readMinutes":2,"scenes":[{"label":"hook","text":"Ravi helped at his uncle's shop, where boxes of pencils were stacked up to the roof."},{"label":"problem","text":"There were 6 shelves with 9 boxes on each shelf, and Ravi had to count them quickly for his uncle."},{"label":"mathMoment","text":"He split the 9 into 3 and 3, and saw that 6 times 9 is the same as 6 times 3 times 3."},{"label":"wrapUp","text":"Ravi told his uncle the answer at once, and his uncle laughed with joy."}],"visual":null,"equations":["6 × 9 = 6 × 3 x ___"],"tryTogether":{"question":"You have 7 rows of 4 stickers.
